overloadMerges.semanticRole: Create a new shared collection, optionally prefilled with one or more values, whose elements can be safely accessed from multiple processes/workers under Use...End use.
overloadMerges.note: Same optional-parenthesized-variadic pattern as New collection defeated the mechanical parser (empty params draft); replaced with a 0..n variadic group for 'value'.

constraints: Adding an element via the assignment operator (e.g. mySharedCol[i]:=...) must be wrapped in Use...End use, otherwise an error is generated; this is not required when adding elements via collection methods that already implement their own thread-safety.
